description: PitchBook offers private-market company, deal, investor and fund data through a contract-based REST API.
auth_notes: apiKey scheme named pbToken, sent in the Authorization header; issued only after contract signing.
gate_detail: No developer signup or key button; access goes through the Direct Data team under a separate contract. Credentials arrive after signing; a sandbox exists only once in the process.
api_scope: OpenAPI-defined APIs for account information, companies, credit analysis, deals, fundamentals, funds, investors, limited partners, patents, people and service providers.
mcp_notes: Directory data says no MCP server; a connector for Claude and ChatGPT is mentioned but not described as an MCP endpoint.
blocker_detail: API access requires a separate contract negotiated with PitchBook's Direct Data team, on top of a platform subscription.

evidence.quote: PitchBook secures its APIs with apiKey across 1 declared security scheme
API access requires a separate contract from the PitchBook Platform.
credentials only arrive after a contract is signed
PitchBook offers a REST API for retrieving private-market data into internal systems.
A sandbox environment exists for pre-production testing once you’re in the process.

uncertainties: Official MCP status is unclear; only a platform connector is mentioned.
